rationale: Nitrogen limitation (4.5 mmol N available vs. 10 mmol N needed per gDW) restricts growth to 0.35 /h. Co-fermentation of abundant acetate (8 mmol/gDW/h) with N-rich amino acids (serine, alanine, cysteine) balances C and N uptake. Fermentation products (propionate, butyrate, formate, lactate) are consistent with my anaerobic metabolism. Carbon audit: 26 mmol C in → 14.7 (growth) + 11.3 (fermentation products) = 26.0 mmol C. Confidence moderate due to complex regulatory interactions in amino acid fermentation.
